$comment: Moissanite grading reference. Colour and clarity scales follow the GIA diamond grading system, which the moissanite trade has adopted. Values are descriptive only and are not a GIA certification.

colour.scale: GIA D-Z (moissanite is commonly sold in the D-K range)

grades.note: Highest grade. No detectable colour under 10x magnification against a white background.
Minute traces of colour, detectable only by a trained grader.
Slight colour detectable by an expert; still classed as colourless.
Colour noticeable only when compared side by side with D-F.
Appears colourless face-up in most settings.
Slight warmth visible face-up to a careful eye.
Warmth visible face-up, more so in larger stones.
Faint yellow visible to the unaided eye; often paired with yellow gold.

clarity.scale: GIA FL-I3 (most moissanite sold is VVS or better)

grades.name: Internally Flawless
grades.visible_10x: No inclusions; minor surface blemishes only

grades.name: Very Very Slightly Included 1
grades.visible_10x: Inclusions extremely difficult to see at 10x

grades.name: Very Very Slightly Included 2
grades.visible_10x: Inclusions very difficult to see at 10x

grades.name: Very Slightly Included 2
grades.visible_10x: Inclusions somewhat easy to see at 10x

optical.$comment: Published gemmological constants. These are what actually separate moissanite from diamond.
